name: created_at
description: UTC time the app received the answer (server time, not the browser's)

name: business_date
description: Business date of the incident that was investigated

name: incident_id
description: The triage's stable incident id for that date

name: title
description: Incident title as shown to L1 (capped at 200 characters)

name: verdict
description: right | direction | wrong — the person's rating of the investigation's finding

name: actual_cause
description: What the cause really was, in the person's own words, as typed (capped at 500 characters); runbook material when the verdict is wrong

name: category
description: The incident's category from the triage

name: action
description: The L1 action the investigation recommended (wait | retrigger | check | escalate)

name: model
description: Model that wrote the finding; empty when no model was involved

name: actor
description: The verified signed-in email of who answered; empty when identity is off — never a typed value
